impacts.explanation: Reduced trade deficit improves capital inflows and consumer confidence.
Export growth contributes to GDP expansion.

scenarios.reasoning: Historical trade negotiations show 60% success rate in reducing deficits within 12 months; current political will aligns with past patterns (Outside View).
